scope_note: Decisions are evidence-sensitive and provisional; do not promote blocked claims.

claims.reason: A 2023 survey/proposal explicitly describes the workflow.

claims.claim: First assessment of top LLMs for South Asian music
claims.reason: A June 2026 preprint evaluated 33 models on South Asian music tasks; distinct questions do not restore broad first claim.

claims.claim: Discovered shortcut learning as a new phenomenon
claims.reason: Shortcut learning and heuristic exploitation are established.
Established behavioural, contrast, and counterfactual testing.
Explainable audio-based Raag identification already published as a preprint; narrower task claim unverified.
Indic NLP models and multilingual benchmarks are established.

claims.claim: World-first system combining all listed features
claims.reason: An exhaustive novelty assertion cannot be supported by this targeted search.
Existing coded traces lack mechanism-level faithfulness comparison.
Balanced metadata is an instance of known counterfactual controls, not shown to be new.

claims.claim: Superior to GPT/Gemini/Suno or commercial music models
claims.reason: No hosted-LLM outputs or matched task comparison in repository.

claims.claim: Musically correct Raag recommendation on authentic poetry
claims.reason: No independent human ratings or genuine Raag labels.

claims.claim: Proven robust semantic understanding across scripts
claims.reason: Synthetic script-mode outputs are not parallel-translation pairs.

claims.claim: New untouched holdout confirms shortcut behavior
claims.reason: The same small synthetic test split was reused across upgrades.
No patent/novelty legal search, technical comparison, or new-method demonstration.
Existing scripts and synthetic results support a transparent case study, not fundamental methodological novelty.

claims.claim: Time-token intervention changes metadata-driven model predictions in synthetic setting
claims.reason: Descriptive effect under known generator confounding; not a novel phenomenon nor independent real-world result.

claims.claim: Locally reproducible baseline comparison with eight methods
claims.reason: Internal exploratory comparison against eight local methods, not state-of-the-art hosted LLM evaluation.

claims.claim: Proposed cross-script music-rule-plus-text robustness research question
claims.reason: Combination may merit study; cannot assert absence of prior work or generalizable novelty.
